description: This file defines a utility class `FineractFeignClientHelper` for creating and configuring instances of `FineractFeignClient`, primarily used to facilitate communication with the Fineract API in integration tests. It provides factory methods for creating clients with default credentials, custom credentials, and optional debugging.

classes.name: FineractFeignClientHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to instantiate and configure `FineractFeignClient` instances with different settings for integration testing.

methods.name: getFineractFeignClient
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the default `FineractFeignClient` configured with default credentials.

methods.name: createNewFineractFeignClient
methods.description: Creates a new `FineractFeignClient` with specified username and password.

methods.name: createNewFineractFeignClient
methods.description: Creates a new `FineractFeignClient` with specified username, password, and debug option.

methods.name: createNewFineractFeignClient
methods.description: Creates a new `FineractFeignClient` with custom configuration applied via a Consumer, including credentials and optional debug mode.

methods.name: buildURI
methods.description: Constructs the base URI for the Fineract API from system properties.
